build_quantile_q_network: build a Quantile DQN Q-network using the Quantile net builder with custom sizes and activations
create_quantile_net_builder: create a Quantile net builder instance with default hidden layer sizes of 256 and 128
configure_quantile_activations: configure the Quantile net builder with custom activation functions like relu or tanh
review_quantile_class: review the Quantile class to understand how it extends QRDQNNetBuilder and builds FullyConnectedDQN models
test_quantile_validation: test the Quantile class post-init validation that sizes and activations lists have matching lengths
